title: On-demand optical control of coherent magnon frequency in nanometer-thick magnets
core_idea: Use visible ultrafast laser pulses combined with an externally applied magnetic field to controllably modify the eigenfrequency of coherent magnons in nanometer-thick bismuth-substituted yttrium iron garnet (BiYIG) by exploiting the interplay among optical excitation, magnetic anisotropy, and the applied field.
tldr: Proposes and investigates an approach for optically and magnetically controllable tuning of magnon frequencies in ultra-thin, room-temperature magnetic films (BiYIG) using visible pump pulses and external-field control as a route toward reconfigurable spintronic/magnonic devices.
